19/// An OpenType font. Can be a TrueType, OpenType font or a TrueType collection.
20/// It holds a reference to the underlying data as well as some basic information
21/// about the font.
22///
23/// Cloning and hashing this type is cheap.
24#[derive(Clone, Hash, Eq, PartialEq)]
25pub struct Font(Arc<Prehashed<Repr>>);
26
27impl Font {
28    /// Create a new font from some data. If you want to create a variable font at a specific
29    /// location, use [`Font::new_variable`] instead.
30    ///
31    /// The `index` indicates the index that should be
32    /// associated with this font for TrueType collections, otherwise this value should be
33    /// set to 0.
34    ///
35    /// Returns `None` if the index is invalid or the font couldn't be read.
36    pub fn new(data: Data, index: u32) -> Option<Self> {
37        Self::new_variable(data, index, &[])
38    }
39
40    /// Like [`Font::new`], creates a new font from some data, but allows you to specify
41    /// variation coordinates in case the font is variable.
42    pub fn new_variable(data: Data, index: u32, variation_coords: &[(Tag, f32)]) -> Option<Self> {
43        let font_info = FontInfo::new(data.as_ref(), index, variation_coords)?;
44
45        Font::new_with_info(data.clone(), Arc::new(font_info))
46    }
47
48    pub(crate) fn new_with_info(data: Data, font_info: Arc<FontInfo>) -> Option<Self> {
49        let yoke_data = YokeData {
50            data: data.0.clone(),
51            location: font_info.location.clone(),
52        };
53
54        let font_ref_yoke = Yoke::<FontRefYoke<'static>, Box<YokeData>>::attach_to_cart(
55            Box::new(yoke_data),
56            |data| {
57                let font_ref =
58                    FontRef::from_index(data.data.as_ref().as_ref(), font_info.index).unwrap();
59                FontRefYoke {
60                    font_ref: font_ref.clone(),
61                    glyph_metrics: font_ref.glyph_metrics(Size::unscaled(), &data.location),
62                    outline_glyphs: font_ref.outline_glyphs(),
63                }
64            },
65        );
66
67        Some(Font(Arc::new(Prehashed::new(Repr {
68            font_data: data,
69            font_ref_yoke,
70            font_info,
71        }))))
72    }
73
74    pub(crate) fn postscript_name(&self) -> Option<&str> {
75        self.0.font_info.postscript_name.as_deref()
76    }
77
78    /// Return the index of the font.
79    pub(crate) fn index(&self) -> u32 {
80        self.font_info().index
81    }
82
83    pub(crate) fn font_info(&self) -> Arc<FontInfo> {
84        self.0.font_info.clone()
85    }
86
87    pub(crate) fn variation_coordinates(&self) -> &[(Tag, FiniteF32)] {
88        &self.0.font_info.var_coords
89    }
90
91    pub(crate) fn cap_height(&self) -> Option<f32> {
92        self.0.font_info.cap_height.map(|n| n.get())
93    }
94
95    pub(crate) fn ascent(&self) -> f32 {
96        self.0.font_info.ascent.get()
97    }
98
99    pub(crate) fn weight(&self) -> f32 {
100        self.0.font_info.weight.get()
101    }
102
103    pub(crate) fn stretch(&self) -> f32 {
104        self.0.font_info.stretch.get()
105    }
106
107    pub(crate) fn descent(&self) -> f32 {
108        self.0.font_info.descent.get()
109    }
110
111    pub(crate) fn num_glyphs(&self) -> u32 {
112        self.0.font_info.num_glyphs
113    }
114
115    pub(crate) fn is_monospaced(&self) -> bool {
116        self.0.font_info.is_monospaced
117    }
118
119    pub(crate) fn italic_angle(&self) -> f32 {
120        self.0.font_info.italic_angle.get()
121    }
122
123    /// The units per em of the font.
124    pub fn units_per_em(&self) -> f32 {
125        self.0.font_info.units_per_em as f32
126    }
127
128    pub(crate) fn bbox(&self) -> Rect {
129        self.0.font_info.global_bbox
130    }
131
132    pub(crate) fn location_ref(&self) -> LocationRef<'_> {
133        (&self.0.font_info.location).into()
134    }
135
136    pub(crate) fn font_ref(&self) -> &FontRef<'_> {
137        &self.0.font_ref_yoke.get().font_ref
138    }
139
140    pub(crate) fn glyph_metrics(&self) -> &GlyphMetrics<'_> {
141        &self.0.font_ref_yoke.get().glyph_metrics
142    }
143
144    pub(crate) fn outline_glyphs(&self) -> &OutlineGlyphCollection<'_> {
145        &self.0.font_ref_yoke.get().outline_glyphs
146    }
147
148    pub(crate) fn font_data(&self) -> Data {
149        self.0.font_data.clone()
150    }
151
152    #[inline]
153    pub(crate) fn advance_width(&self, glyph_id: GlyphId) -> Option<f32> {
154        self.glyph_metrics().advance_width(glyph_id.to_skrifa())
155    }
156}

158/// A 4-byte OpenType tag.
159#[derive(Copy, Debug, Clone, Eq, PartialEq, Ord, PartialOrd, Hash)]
160pub struct Tag([u8; 4]);
161
162impl Tag {
163    /// Create a new tag.
164    pub fn new(tag: &[u8; 4]) -> Self {
165        Self(*tag)
166    }
167
168    /// Try to create a new tag from a string.
169    ///
170    /// Return `None` if the string is not 4 bytes in size.
171    pub fn try_from_str(s: &str) -> Option<Self> {
172        let tag: [u8; 4] = s.as_bytes().try_into().ok()?;
173
174        Some(Self(tag))
175    }
176
177    /// Return the value of the tag.
178    pub fn get(&self) -> &[u8; 4] {
179        &self.0
180    }
181}

202/// `FontInfo` holds basic information about the font which is necessary
203/// to distinguish a `Font` object from others. The `Hash` implementation
204/// of the `Font` struct solely depends on its `FontInfo` object. The reason
205/// we do this is to avoid hashing the whole font, which can be dozens of megabytes.
206/// Instead, we parse the most basic information as well as additional distinguishing
207/// information, such as the font name and the checksum, and has this instead.
208/// This is much faster, and since we also include the checksum, the odds of two
209/// different fonts ending up with the same hash is pretty much zero.
210#[derive(Debug, Hash, Eq, PartialEq)]
211pub(crate) struct FontInfo {
212    index: u32,
213    checksum: u32,
214    data_len: usize,
215    // `location` is derived from `var_coords`, but we need to store `var_coords` it explicitly
216    // so we can later pass it to the subsetter.
217    var_coords: Vec<(Tag, FiniteF32)>,
218    location: Location,
219    units_per_em: u16,
220    global_bbox: Rect,
221    num_glyphs: u32,
222    postscript_name: Option<String>,
223    ascent: FiniteF32,
224    descent: FiniteF32,
225    cap_height: Option<FiniteF32>,
226    is_monospaced: bool,
227    italic_angle: FiniteF32,
228    weight: FiniteF32,
229    has_glyf: bool,
230    has_cff: bool,
231    has_cff2: bool,
232    stretch: FiniteF32,
233}
234
235struct Repr {
236    font_info: Arc<FontInfo>,
237    font_data: Data,
238    font_ref_yoke: Yoke<FontRefYoke<'static>, Box<YokeData>>,
239}
240
241impl Hash for Repr {
242    fn hash<H: Hasher>(&self, state: &mut H) {
243        // We assume that if the font info is distinct, the font itself is distinct as well. This
244        // doesn't have to be the case: while the font does have a checksum, it's "only" a
245        // u32. The proper way would be to hash the whole font data, but this is just too expensive.
246        // However, the odds of the checksum AND all font metrics (including font name) being the same
247        // with the font being different is diminishingly low.
248        self.font_info.hash(state);
249    }
250}
251
252impl FontInfo {
253    pub(crate) fn new(data: &[u8], index: u32, var_coords: &[(Tag, f32)]) -> Option<Self> {
254        let font_ref = FontRef::from_index(data, index).ok()?;
255        let location = font_ref.axes().location(
256            var_coords
257                .iter()
258                .map(|i| (skrifa::Tag::new(i.0.get()), i.1)),
259        );
260        let data_len = data.len();
261        let checksum = font_ref.head().ok()?.checksum_adjustment();
262        let num_glyphs = font_ref.glyph_names().num_glyphs();
263
264        let metrics = font_ref.metrics(Size::unscaled(), &location);
265        let os_2 = font_ref.os2().ok();
266        let ascent = FiniteF32::new(
267            os_2.as_ref()
268                .map(|s| s.s_typo_ascender() as f32)
269                .unwrap_or(metrics.ascent),
270        )?;
271        let descent = FiniteF32::new(
272            os_2.as_ref()
273                .map(|s| s.s_typo_descender() as f32)
274                .unwrap_or(metrics.descent),
275        )?;
276        let is_monospaced = metrics.is_monospace;
277        let cap_height = metrics.cap_height.map(|n| FiniteF32::new(n).unwrap());
278        let italic_angle = FiniteF32::new(metrics.italic_angle).unwrap();
279        let weight = FiniteF32::new(font_ref.attributes().weight.value())?;
280        let stretch = FiniteF32::new(font_ref.attributes().stretch.ratio())?;
281        let units_per_em = metrics.units_per_em;
282
283        let global_bbox = metrics
284            .bounds
285            .and_then(|b| Rect::from_ltrb(b.x_min, b.y_min, b.x_max, b.y_max))
286            .unwrap_or(Rect::from_xywh(
287                0.0,
288                0.0,
289                units_per_em as f32,
290                units_per_em as f32,
291            )?);
292
293        let postscript_name = {
294            if let Ok(name) = font_ref.name() {
295                name.name_record().iter().find_map(|n| {
296                    if n.name_id.get() == NameId::POSTSCRIPT_NAME {
297                        if let Ok(string) = n.string(name.string_data()) {
298                            return Some(string.to_string());
299                        }
300                    }
301
302                    None
303                })
304            } else {
305                None
306            }
307        };
308
309        let has_glyf = font_ref.glyf().is_ok();
310        let has_cff = font_ref.cff().is_ok();
311        let has_cff2 = font_ref.cff2().is_ok();
312
313        Some(FontInfo {
314            index,
315            data_len,
316            checksum,
317            var_coords: var_coords
318                .iter()
319                .map(|v| (v.0, FiniteF32::new(v.1).unwrap_or_default()))
320                .collect(),
321            location,
322            num_glyphs,
323            units_per_em,
324            postscript_name,
325            ascent,
326            cap_height,
327            has_glyf,
328            has_cff,
329            has_cff2,
330            descent,
331            is_monospaced,
332            weight,
333            stretch,
334            italic_angle,
335            global_bbox,
336        })
337    }
338
339    pub(crate) fn can_be_cid_font(&self) -> bool {
340        self.has_cff || self.has_glyf || self.has_cff2
341    }
342}

344/// A yoke so that we can attach a `FontRef` object to the corresponding `Font`,
345/// without running into lifetime issues.
346#[derive(Yokeable, Clone)]
347struct FontRefYoke<'a> {
348    pub font_ref: FontRef<'a>,
349    pub glyph_metrics: GlyphMetrics<'a>,
350    pub outline_glyphs: OutlineGlyphCollection<'a>,
351}
